reply_text:
I told Marcus to send the truck to Door 28, in a threaded reply in his DM.

That door comes from the workspace brain, which has a note saved from his direct messages with me on Oct 14. In it, Marcus said Door 28 is his dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups on the Tamarack project "from now on." The brain marks that note as unconfirmed, and when I read the DM itself, only today's message is there, so I couldn't check it against the original message.

The brain had nothing newer about that dock. I suggested he check with Tamsin's receiving desk before Thursday in case anything has moved. The door number came from Marcus's own DM with me, so I shared it only with him.
